metadata.name: 手柄的“R键”
metadata.description:
用手柄快速重开！在单人局中，把 Xbox 手柄的[b]右摇杆（RS）向下按住 1.25 秒[/b]。进度到满后，用当前角色直接开新一局。
[list] [*]屏幕下方会显示长按进度。提前松开或暂停可取消。 [*]每次长按只重开一次。进入新局后，松开再按即可再次重开。 [*]适用于 PC 版 Repentance 和 Repentance+，无需额外模组。伊甸和里伊甸请使用游戏自带的重开操作，以沿用原版的伊甸币规则。 [/list]
[h2]Controller Quick Restart[/h2] In a solo run, [b]click and hold the Xbox right stick (RS) for 1.25 seconds[/b] to start a fresh run with the current character.
[list] [*]Watch the on-screen progress. Release the stick or pause to cancel. [*]Holding through the transition only restarts once. Release and hold again for another restart. [*]For PC Repentance and Repentance+. No mod dependencies. Use the game's built-in restart for Eden and Tainted Eden to preserve the normal token rules. [/list]
